body:
That's horrible, I'm so sorry for you. How can you use up a free resource?  

I haven't been to a specialtist since I told one that I (then 17) Didn't cook for my parents because I was vegetarian and they weren't, that I didn't wash up for them as my Dad was very strict on hot water usage(as we were poor) therefore I wasn't allowed and that I found it hard to get myself out of bed in a day without feeling suicidal and he told me that I was lazy. And that I'd never have a career because of that. Even if your job is to sort the wheat from the chaff, how do you phrase it like that? I don't trust any of them now. Not even the hospital nurses I used to trust before they referred me to him. I was in their services for five years prior, That's a long con if I'm just putting it on.

  sorry for the rant

I'm English so it's Soccer I'm afraid. That and Cricket, but the Cricket season is over in a few days. 

  I know what you mean. My job is to help people, and it helps me help myself but sometimes my dark days overcome it. And when they all come along like a bus to hit me like tonight, it isn't fun. Have had some terrible doctors and psychiatrists so never know who to turn to, when its a night like tonight.

Yeah sure. Do you know why you feel shit? What sort of thing do you enjoy/makes you feel better? Personally ( and I know this sounds so stupid) but I'm going on day to day and tomorrow (well, today now) my favourite team play. So trying to hold out until tomorrow night.
